items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So that's when Mr. Nat Nazarr had the idea of injecting us into Buck and Bubbles' act, and that's what he did, see? But he trained us. He trained us for about two and a half years.

ctx.x: No. It was Buck, because he played the piano. So he had us to do our act for him, Nat Nazarrα, and he asked us what music did we want to play, and Mr. Buck, he played -- he was a self-taught musician. And we told him that we did "Sweet Sue". We asked him did he know "Sweet Sue". And

he said, "What tempo?" so we told him the tempo for it. We said, "Do you know 'Broadway Melody'?" and he said, "What tempo?" Bugle Call "Magic Hall Rag," and "What tempo?" So we'd tell him and so that's what he did. And we did our act for Mr. Nat Nazarr, and he was pleased. He liked us. So that's when we had to leave the Belvedere Hotel and go and move in with Mr. Nat Nazarr, because he was looking for a little Buck and Bubbles. He wanted to -- see, Buck and Bubbles was so popular, such great stars. They was big…
